en: Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
zh: 自托管运行器：变更 checkout hook 默认在 30 分钟后被停止，并导致该 session 的初始化失败；如需更长时间，请调高 `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` 或将其设为 `0`
